trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it asks for nothing of its own: earn the other 54 trophies on the list and it unlocks automatically. Treat it as a finish line rather than a task, and plan your whole run around the long poles first — the 100 percent completion gold, the 250 stunts, the shooting-range golds and the big money counters. Work through the six roadmap stages in this guide in order, keep the Missables view checked before you finish the story, and this trophy is simply the last thing that happens. If one trophy is holding it up at the end, it is almost always a counter you stopped feeding early, so glance at your in-progress counts every few sessions.
steps: Earn all other 54 trophies on the official list
Follow the six-stage roadmap so long counters start early
Use the Cleanup stage to sweep whatever remains
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); roadmap structure modelled on GTA V's 100% checklist structure (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission named in the official description, so this trophy is the game's handshake: start a new game, play the introduction through to its end, and the bronze pops on completion. There is nothing to prepare and no choice to make — the mission teaches the basics as it goes, so simply follow its prompts. If you are replaying for a clean tracker, this is the first box you will tick. Take the mission slowly if you like; nothing in the description mentions a time, score or difficulty requirement.
steps: Start the story
Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end
The trophy unlocks on mission completion
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A pure story-progress trophy: finish every mission that makes up Chapter 1 and it unlocks as the chapter closes. Play the chapter in order, follow the story markers, and do not worry about side content yet — everything else on the list stays available while the story is young. Use this chapter to learn the map, the partner mechanics and the wanted system, because later trophies lean on all three. Keep one manual save at the chapter's end; the roadmap's missables strategy starts here as a cheap habit.
steps: Follow the Chapter 1 story markers
Complete the chapter's final mission
Save manually once the chapter closes
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 to earn this one; the name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be skipped, because the story itself is the requirement. By now the open world is properly available, so this is a good moment to start the habits that pay off later: discover vehicles as you meet them, note activity locations, and keep a rolling manual save. Nothing in the chapter's description suggests a performance condition, so a normal clear is enough.
steps: Continue the story into Chapter 2
Complete the chapter's missions in order
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 2 ends
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 for another automatic story bronze. The midpoint of a GTA story is usually where strand missions and activities multiply, so expect the map to fill up around this chapter — resist clearing everything at once and let the roadmap stages sort it. Keep doing strand missions as they appear rather than banking them all for later, because two trophies on this list depend on strand finals that are easy to leave dangling. As ever, a manual save at the chapter boundary costs nothing and insures everything.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's story missions
Start strand missions as they appear
Save manually at the chapter's end
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock this story trophy. Late chapters tend to raise the stakes and shorten the road to the finale, so before you push through this one, glance at the Missables view: partner trophies and any strand you care about are safest finished while the story still has slack in it. The description asks only for completion, not for any medal or condition. Once Chapter 4 closes, you are in endgame territory and the final-mission trophy is the only story gate left.
steps: Complete Chapter 4's missions
Check the Missables view before the finale approaches
Save manually at the chapter's end
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The story's gold: complete the final mission and the campaign is done. Before you start it, run the pre-finale checklist this guide repeats everywhere — finish or secure the partner trophies, push any strand you are mid-way through to its final mission, and keep a manual save from before the point of no return so a locked-out leftover can still be recovered. The description sets no difficulty or performance condition, so play the finale on your normal settings and enjoy it. Everything countable — stunts, races, collectibles, money — can be mopped up afterwards in the Cleanup stage.
steps: Clear the Missables view first
Keep a manual save before the final mission
Complete the final mission
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy: play the story until Breakfast Run appears, complete it, and the bronze is yours. Named missions sit on the critical path, so this needs no hunting — if you are following story markers it will come to you. Mission trophies like this one are also useful tracker landmarks: if Trust has not popped, you have not yet reached the part of the story where Breakfast Run lives. No medal, time or stealth condition is mentioned in the official description.
steps: Follow the story to the mission Breakfast Run
Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks at the mission results
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in this series are set-piece missions with preparation beats, so expect to follow a short chain of story markers before the main event; finishing the heist itself is the whole requirement. Because it is a named story mission it cannot be wandered into early or skipped — progress the campaign and it arrives in sequence. Stock up on armour and ammo when the game prompts you to prepare, purely to make the clear smoother.
steps: Progress the story to The Cartel Heist
Complete any preparation beats the mission sets
Finish the heist to unlock the trophy
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play, named directly in the official description. As with the other named-mission bronzes, the only real instruction is to keep playing the campaign: the mission unlocks in story order and the trophy fires on completion. If you are using spoiler protection in this tracker, the card stays hidden until you earn it, which is exactly what that setting is for. No optional objective is attached to the description.
steps: Follow story markers until Child's Play is available
Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks on completion
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy's shouty name is just flavour; the requirement printed by PlayStation is a plain mission completion, earned in campaign sequence like Trust and Family Matters. Keep following the main markers and it will arrive on its own. If a mission ever feels like a wall, remember the list contains no difficulty trophy at all, so nothing about this unlock depends on settings or style — only on finishing.
steps: Progress the story to Headliners
Complete the mission
The trophy unlocks at completion
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. The initials point at an airport-style location, and another trophy on this list, Catch Me If You Can, also mentions VCIA — while you are there for the story, keep your eyes open for an unscheduled way out, because doubling up saves a trip. The mission itself is on the critical path, so story progress alone delivers this bronze. Completion is the only stated condition.
steps: Progress the story to VCIA Takedown
Complete the mission
While at VCIA, note any unusual exit for Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The military flavour of the name suggests one of the campaign's louder set pieces, but the official requirement is unchanged: reach the mission in story order and finish it. Prepare the way you would for any big mission — full health, armour and ammunition — and the trophy takes care of itself. It is one of the named-mission bronzes that chart your progress through the campaign on the tracker.
steps: Progress the story to Operation Savage Glory
Prepare health, armour and ammo
Complete the mission
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the spine of the whole platinum: reach 100 percent game completion. In this series the completion percentage is a checklist of story, strands, activities, collectibles and discoveries — and this trophy list conveniently names most of its ingredients: the shooting-range golds, 250 stunts, races and drone races, fishing, meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries and full exploration of Leonida. Work the in-game completion screen, where the game shows one, alongside this tracker, and treat every other trophy you earn as a down payment on this one. Start its ingredients early, in parallel with the story, rather than leaving a cold start for the endgame; the counters are long but none of them is hard. Our roadmap puts the main push in Stage 3 for exactly that reason.
steps: Finish the story and all strand finals
Clear activities: range golds, stunts, races, drone races, fishing, meditation
Clear collectibles and exploration, then check the completion total
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); completion structure modelled on GTA V's 100% checklist structure (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Two hundred and fifty stunts is one of the longest counters on the list, so the winning method is rhythm, not heroics: start during the story, bank a handful of stunts whenever you cross the map, and never leave them all for one sitting. Use a fast, sturdy vehicle, learn what the game counts as a stunt early — a clean jump with a clean landing is the safe assumption until the game teaches you otherwise — and repeat reliable jump spots once you find ones that register every time. Because stunts almost certainly feed the 100 percent completion gold as well, every stunt is double value. If a jump keeps failing to register, change the vehicle or the approach angle rather than grinding a broken spot.
steps: Learn what registers as a stunt early in the story
Bank stunts in small batches on every trip
Repeat reliable jump spots until the count reaches 250
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); pacing modelled on GTA V's stunt-jump completion structure (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: try each type of activity once. The list itself names the activity family — shooting range, stunts, races, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation and challenges all appear in their own trophies — so work through the activity icons on the map and do one of each. You do not need to win or medal anything here; a single honest attempt at each type is what the description asks for. This is also the perfect scouting run for A Long Road, because afterwards you will know which activities you enjoy and which to schedule in short sessions. Tick types off in this tracker as you try them so none is forgotten.
steps: Open the map and list every distinct activity icon
Play one session of each activity type
Confirm every type has been tried at least once
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in every Shooting Range challenge — the starter guide counts 42 of them — makes this the list's purest skill trophy. Treat it as a season, not a session: learn one weapon category at a time, replay a challenge immediately while its target pattern is fresh, and leave a stubborn gold for tomorrow rather than tilting at it tonight. Accuracy streaks usually beat raw speed in range scoring, so slow down until the pattern is memorised, then add pace. Because range golds are a classic ingredient of the 100 percent checklist in this series, assume they also feed A Long Road and prioritise them in Stage 3. Warm up on a challenge you have already golded before attempting a new one.
steps: Clear each range challenge once to learn its pattern
Replay for gold one weapon category at a time
Repeat until all 42 challenges hold a gold medal
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); challenge count as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 of them, per the starter data drawn from the official list. Winning once per location is the requirement, so learn each course with a sighting lap, then race it properly: smooth lines through gates beat frantic corrections, and the lap you win is usually the calm one. Clear locations region by region so travel time works for you, and mark each win in this tracker immediately, because fourteen similar race names blur together fast. Drone wins likely count toward the activity share of 100 percent completion too.
steps: Visit a Top Fun location and learn the course
Win the race there
Repeat at all 14 locations, ticking each off
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); location count as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win twenty different races — different is the operative word, so farming one easy circuit twenty times will not do it. Spread your wins across the race types and locations the map offers, and pick your battles: a race you can win cleanly in a mid-tier vehicle teaches you the course for harder fields later. Keep a simple tally in this tracker of which races are already won, because the game may not present the twenty as one neat list. Vehicle discovery helps here too — the more of Leonida's garage you have driven, the more likely you own the right tool for each race class.
steps: Enter races across different locations and types
Win each distinct race once
Track wins until 20 different races are won
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal — a named character — in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types on this list, so learn the minigame casually first: how a bite registers, how the catch is played, and what a challenge scores, whether that is weight, count or speed. Then take Cal's challenge seriously on a prepared attempt, with your best available tackle if the game offers upgrades. Named-opponent activities in this series are repeatable until you win, so treat early losses as lessons rather than failures. If Cal's challenge only appears at certain times or spots, the fishing spots you found while exploring are where to look for him.
steps: Learn the fishing minigame at any fishing spot
Find Cal's fishing challenge
Outscore Cal to unlock the trophy
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — a single full play, not a high score and not every cabinet in Leonida. Find an arcade or a lone cabinet, pick the game whose rules you grasp fastest, and play it through to its actual end rather than quitting at the first game-over screen; completion is the word the description uses. This is one of the cheapest bronzes on the list and a natural early tick while you are learning the map. It also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None, so do it during that sampler run.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the world
Choose a game and play it through
Finish the game to unlock the trophy
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — not just his first job, his final one. Strand characters in this series hand out a chain of missions under their own marker, and the trophy only fires when the chain ends, so keep returning to Andy's marker whenever it reappears until the story of the strand resolves. We flag this as missable for a practical reason: a strand left unfinished while the main story races ahead is the classic way players lock themselves out of a strand final, so never overwrite your only save once a strand's last mission is available, and clear Andy before the endgame. This also feeds Strangers & Freaks, which counts completed strands.
steps: Start Andy's strand when his marker appears
Keep completing his missions as they unlock
Finish his final mission before the endgame
trophies.missable_note: Strand final: finish Andy's chain before the story endgame and keep a save from before his final mission — an unfinished strand is easy to leave locked behind story progress.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strand structure modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks strands (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close his strand. The method mirrors every strand final on this list: follow Kenton's marker through his whole chain, because intermediate missions do not count — only the last one unlocks the trophy. The shark-bite joke in the title is flavour, not a requirement. Flagged missable on the same reasoning as the other strand finals: strands can be skipped or left dangling as the main story advances, so finish Kenton while his missions are current and keep a manual save before his finale. Each strand final also moves Strangers & Freaks closer.
steps: Start Kenton's strand from his marker
Complete his missions in sequence
Finish his final mission
trophies.missable_note: Strand final: Kenton's chain can be skipped past as the story advances — complete it and keep a pre-finale save.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strand structure modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks strands (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing his final mission. Work his marker whenever it is up, in order, and do not assume a mid-strand mission was the last one — strand finals in this series often arrive after a gap in in-game time, so if Billy goes quiet, advance a day, finish another mission, and check the map again. We flag it missable because strand finals are the most commonly abandoned content in a long open-world story: the cure is simply to close the strand while it is active and to hold a save from before its last mission. One more strand toward the eight Strangers & Freaks needs.
steps: Take Billy's missions from his marker
Wait and recheck if the strand pauses between missions
Complete his final mission
trophies.missable_note: Strand final: Billy's last mission can be left behind by story progress — finish the strand while it is active.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strand structure modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks strands (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The silver that organises Stage 2: complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand counts when it is finished, not when it is started, so this trophy is really the sum of the strand finals — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone have their own bronzes, and you will need strands beyond those five to reach eight, which means talking to strangers whenever a new marker appears anywhere in the state. Prioritise strands early, while their markers are fresh and the story has not moved their characters on. Keep a running count in this tracker; the moment your eighth strand closes, the silver pops.
steps: Accept every stranger strand marker you find
Finish strands completely, not just their openers
Repeat until 8 strands are complete
trophies.missable_note: Depends on strand finals that can be skipped: if strands are left unfinished as the story advances, reaching 8 completed strands can be locked out — do strands as they appear.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strand structure modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks strands (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission to end his strand. As with Andy, Kenton and Billy, only the last mission in the chain unlocks anything, so treat Randy's marker as a standing appointment: whenever it appears, it outranks free-roam wandering. The title hints at trade, so expect his chain to involve moving goods or money — useful practice for the laundering and robbery trophies later in the roadmap. Flagged missable for the standard strand reason: finish it before the endgame crowds it out, and keep a save from before the finale.
steps: Start Randy's strand at his marker
Complete each of his missions as they unlock
Finish his final mission
trophies.missable_note: Strand final: complete Randy's chain before the endgame and keep a save from before his final mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strand structure modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks strands (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand with his final mission. The playbook is the strand playbook: take his missions in order, return after any in-game pause, and recognise that the trophy belongs to the finale alone. Tyrone's is one of the five named strand finals, so it counts double — its own bronze plus one of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks requires. We flag it missable because a strand final left pending while the campaign ends is the textbook lock-out in this genre; clear it in Stage 2 and hold a pre-finale save.
steps: Follow Tyrone's marker and start his strand
Work through his missions in order
Complete his final mission
trophies.missable_note: Strand final: Tyrone's chain can be skipped past — finish it during Stage 2, not after the finale.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strand structure modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks strands (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots, per the starter data drawn from the official list. Spots in this series sit in scenic, quiet places: rooftops, beaches, hilltops and lookouts, so fold the hunt into exploration for The Goodtime State and meditate whenever a spot icon appears near you. One session per spot is the whole ask; there is no score to chase. Because the spots are scattered statewide, a region-by-region sweep late in Stage 3 is far faster than hunting them one at a time from across the map. Tick each spot off as you go so the last two are easy to find.
steps: Note meditation spots while exploring each region
Meditate once at each spot
Sweep region by region until all 18 are done
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); spot count as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a named character with a one-of-a-kind target, which is why we flag this trophy as missable: unique encounters tied to a person are exactly the content a story can move past. When Bret's request is active, make it your next job rather than a someday job, prepare like a hunter — approach quietly, bring a suitable long-range weapon if the game allows, and save before the hunt so a spooked or botched attempt can be retried from the save rather than lost. The description asks for the hunt itself, not a clean or undamaged kill, so a messy success still counts. If Bret appears as part of a strand, finishing his strand promptly covers this too.
steps: Take Bret's hunting request when it appears
Save before tracking the unique animal
Hunt the animal and report back to Bret
trophies.missable_note: A unique-animal hunt for a named character is a one-off encounter — take it when Bret offers it and save before the hunt.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Sets, not loose cards, are the unit here, so the efficient method is focus: pick the set you are closest to finishing, hunt its remaining cards, close it, then move to the next — three finished sets beat ninety percent of five sets. Collectible cards in open worlds hide in interiors, on counters, tables and shelves, so search buildings you enter for story reasons instead of making joyless dedicated trips early on. Keep a per-set tally outside the game if the game does not show one; knowing a set needs two cards changes how you explore. This silver pairs naturally with the exploration trophy, since both reward thorough map coverage.
steps: Choose the card set nearest completion
Hunt its remaining cards in interiors and landmarks
Close 3 full sets
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); set-based collecting modelled on Red Dead Redemption 2's cigarette card sets (Rockstar Games, 2018)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. Whatever WAiNK turns out to be in-world — the capitalisation suggests an app, service or terminal network — the trophy's shape is clear from its description: a hundred distinct locations, one interaction each. That makes it a background counter to feed constantly: whenever you pass a WAiNK point, use it, the way you would tap a collectible, and the hundred will arrive long before a dedicated grind would suggest. Locations almost certainly cluster in commercial areas, so city districts will fill the count fastest. If the game shows a WAiNK total anywhere, check it monthly in tracker terms — after each stage — so a shortfall is never a surprise at cleanup.
steps: Use WAiNK at every location you pass
Work commercial districts for dense clusters
Continue until 100 distinct locations are logged
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete fifty challenges. Challenges are the game's short-form objectives, and fifty is a mid-size counter best fed steadily: clear challenges as they surface during other work — a driving challenge on a drive you were making anyway, a combat challenge inside a mission replay — and the fifty accumulate without a dedicated grind. If the game lists challenges by category, spread across categories early, because the easy openers in each category are the cheapest completions on the list. Late in Stage 4, switch to deliberate farming of whatever repeatable challenge you finish fastest. This counter likely contributes to the activity share of 100 percent completion as well.
steps: Complete challenges opportunistically during other trophies
Spread across challenge categories for easy completions
Farm the fastest repeatable challenge until 50 are done
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a four-star wanted level, then lose it and fully escape the heat. The craft is in the escape, not the crime: commit something loud enough to reach four stars quickly, then break line of sight, swap vehicles away from watching eyes if the game allows, and hide until the stars drain. We flag this missable because it is partner-dependent — it needs the partner present, and partner availability is tied to story beats, so do it during the story while the two of you are travelling together, not in a lonely endgame. Pick an escape area you know, near cover and a change of car, before you start the trouble.
steps: Travel with your partner during the story
Raise a 4-star wanted level together
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level is lost
trophies.missable_note: Partner-dependent: it needs your partner with you, and partner availability follows story beats — do it during the story, not after the finale.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in an unbroken chain with your partner, keeping a wanted level alive the whole time. Plan the route before the first robbery: choose three shops close together in one district, memorise the drive between them, and keep moving — the chain breaks if your wanted level fully clears, so dawdle nowhere and do not hide. Your partner must be with you, which is why this is flagged missable and scheduled in Stage 1: partner time belongs to the story, so chain the robberies on a story day when you are already together. A fast, durable car parked facing the exit turns the hardest part — the transitions — into the easiest.
steps: Pick 3 shops close together and plan the route
With your partner, rob the first shop and keep the wanted level up
Drive straight to the second and third shops without losing the heat
trophies.missable_note: Partner-dependent and chained: needs your partner and an unbroken wanted level — attempt it during the story while travelling together.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover one hundred different vehicles. Discovery in this series usually means getting in and driving, so the method is cheerful opportunism: never walk past a vehicle model you have not driven, steal broadly, and treat every new district as a showroom — ports, farms, beaches and rich neighbourhoods each park different metal. Emergency and service vehicles count toward variety in past games of the series, so ambulances, trucks and work vehicles are worth a hop-in too. Start from the first hour; a hundred discoveries gathered passively cost nothing, while a hundred hunted at cleanup cost an evening. The Scooter Bros trophy, which registers vehicles to an app, pairs naturally with this one.
steps: Enter every new vehicle model you see
Hunt variety in ports, farms, beaches and wealthy districts
Continue until 100 vehicles are discovered
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside one use of Combat Focus, the game's slow-motion aiming state. Setup is everything: you need a crowd, so pick a fight with at least five enemies in one area — a gang operation or a busy robbery escape — then trigger Combat Focus only when all five are visible and in range. Line targets up before you activate, start with the enemies most likely to move or shoot first, and use a weapon with enough ammunition to finish the sequence without a reload. If an attempt fails, the trophy costs nothing to retry; engineer a denser crowd rather than faster fingers. Gang operations for Pest Control are a reliable place to find the crowd this needs.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies in one area
Position so all are visible, then trigger Combat Focus
Take down 5 enemies before the effect ends
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport-style location that also hosts the story mission VCIA Takedown. In plain terms, our reading of the description is: leave VCIA in a way the airport would not approve of, most plausibly by taking an aircraft or vehicle out without authorisation; that reading is an inference from the wording, labelled as such. We flag it as missable as a precaution, because the surest chance may come while the story itself has you at VCIA: when you are there for VCIA Takedown, look for the opportunity then instead of assuming free roam will offer it again. If free roam does allow it, any unauthorised departure should do — the description names the act, not a mission.
steps: Go to VCIA, ideally during or after VCIA Takedown
Find an aircraft or vehicle you can take out unofficially
Depart VCIA without authorisation
trophies.missable_note: Precaution: the description points at one specific place and act, and the story visit for VCIA Takedown may be the surest chance — look for the departure while you are there.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); interpretation of 'unscheduled departure' is editorial inference from that wording

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately cryptic — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — so honesty first: this reading is an inference. Rhino is the series' long-running name for its military tank, so the most reasonable interpretation is that the trophy involves a Rhino tank, most plausibly driving one, surviving in one, or enduring heat — police pressure or literal fire — while in one. When you first get access to a Rhino, experiment in a save you can reload: drive it, raise a wanted level in it, and stay in it under fire, and one of those readings should pop the trophy. Do not build your route around a more specific claim than that; the description does not support one. If it unlocks during a story set piece involving armour, so much the better — note what you were doing and move on.
steps: Find or commandeer a Rhino tank (inference from the description)
Save, then experiment: drive it, raise heat in it, endure fire in it
Reload and vary the attempt until the trophy unlocks
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); Rhino interpretation is editorial inference, Rhino being the series' tank name in GTA V (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection — the stealth entry in the crime family. Scout the store first in daylight free roam: note the staff, the counters, the exits and any cameras or guards the game models, then attempt the robbery quietly, taking valuables and leaving before anyone raises the alarm. If detection is triggered by being seen rather than by noise, move slowly and stay out of sightlines; if a silent approach fails, try entering near closing activity or from a rear entrance if the store has one. A failed attempt costs only a retry, so treat the first run as reconnaissance. Save outside the store so every attempt starts clean.
steps: Scout a jewelry store: staff, exits, sightlines
Save outside, then enter quietly
Take the valuables and leave without being detected
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one — the silver anchor of the money stage. A vault robbery is a two-part test: the robbery itself, then a clean escape, and the trophy counts only vaults you escaped from, so plan the getaway before you go in — vehicle placed, route chosen, a change of car or hiding spot in mind. Work up to vaults through the smaller crime trophies first; shops, trucks and gang operations teach the wanted system that vault escapes will stress hardest. Five different vaults is the natural reading of the description, so spread across banks rather than repeating one. Bank the proceeds toward the laundering and spending counters while you are at it.
steps: Prepare a getaway vehicle and escape route
Rob a bank vault
Escape cleanly, then repeat at 5 vaults
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks in this series run fixed routes and resist casual damage, so ambush smart: block the truck's path with a heavy vehicle, deal with its guards quickly, and open the rear by whatever method the game teaches — in past games that meant explosives on the doors, which is precedent, not a promise. The escape is half the trophy, so stage your own fast car nearby facing away from the scene. Once you have done one, you also own a repeatable money source for the spending and laundering counters in Stage 5.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Block it, deal with the guards and open the rear
Take the money and escape the wanted level
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); method modelled on GTA V's armored truck robberies (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the starter data counts 52 areas. Exploration trophies reward coverage, not tourism: an area usually registers when you enter it properly, so drive its streets rather than clipping its border at speed. The painless method is to explore as a by-product — story trips, strand visits, meditation spots and card hunts will clear most of the map — then sweep whatever fog remains region by region in Stage 3, deliberately touring the rural corners story missions rarely visit. Water and islands are the classic forgotten areas in coastal maps, so check the shoreline last. Pair the final sweep with WAiNK locations and vehicle discoveries to make one trip pay three times.
steps: Let story and strand travel reveal most areas naturally
Check which of the 52 areas remain unvisited
Sweep the leftovers region by region, including shoreline and islands
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); area count as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — nine gangs, per the starter data drawn from the official list. The discipline here is bookkeeping: one operation per gang, not nine robberies of whichever gang is nearest. Keep a gang checklist in your head or in this tracker, and when you find an operation, identify its owners before you hit it so the robbery counts toward a gang you still need. These operations double as perfect Combat Focus practice, since they offer the dense enemy groups Gunslinger wants, and as income for Stage 5. Expect the last gang to be the hunt; operations in territories you rarely visit are the usual stragglers.
steps: Identify which gang owns an operation before robbing it
Rob one operation per gang, tracking the 9 gangs
Hunt the remaining gangs' operations in their territories
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); gang count as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — one of the list's gentle trophies, and the title's 'In The Beginning' framing suggests doing it early, which costs nothing: head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or vendor serving cocktails, buy one where the view is the point, and drink it there. The description asks you to enjoy it, so do not rush off mid-drink; let the moment finish. If no vendor is obvious, walk the beachfront strip and check the bars facing the water — a cocktail with a view needs both a drink and a vantage, so an ocean-facing spot is the natural place. It is a two-minute bronze that also reveals an exploration area on the way.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach early in the game
Find an ocean-facing bar or cocktail vendor
Buy and enjoy a cocktail with the view
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — meaning: steal a car from inside a showroom and exit through the glass rather than the door. We flag this as a precautionary missable, because set-piece moments tied to one interior can be tied to a story visit; if a mission ever takes you into a showroom, take the loud exit then. In free roam, the method is simple to attempt: enter a showroom, get into a display vehicle, and drive it straight out through the window frontage. 'Classic style' is flavour, an inference on our part that it nods to the series' long tradition of exactly this exit. If the first showroom's glass will not break in free roam, that is your signal the moment belongs to a story beat — watch for it there.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom (a story visit is the surest chance)
Get into a display vehicle
Drive out through the glass frontage
trophies.missable_note: Precaution: a specific set-piece act in one interior — if the story takes you into a showroom, take the glass exit then rather than assuming free roam offers it.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); 'classic style' reading is editorial inference from the wording

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description names a place and an act: the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, and a follow-through — the swing a bowler finishes with. Our plain reading is that you bowl at that alley and complete your throw; the wording is playful rather than cryptic, but the exact trigger is the alley's own bowling activity, so go there, play bowling properly, and finish a game or at least a full frame sequence with real throws. A named-location trophy like this is a map errand: find the alley, walk in, and play. If a single throw does not pop it, complete the full game before concluding anything — activity trophies in this list consistently ask for completion, not a taste. It also ticks bowling toward Master of None if bowling is one of its activity types.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start a bowling game there
Play with proper throws, completing the game if needed
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Another deliberately cryptic description: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' Labelled honestly, our interpretation is an inference: the trophy most plausibly celebrates a moment where the two partners do something publicly popular — a stunt, performance or feat in front of a crowd, or something that draws attention in-world. The practical method follows from that reading: while travelling with your partner during the story, take the showy options — big stunts, public activities, anything with an audience — and watch for the pop after crowd-pleasing moments. Because the reading is uncertain, treat this as a Cleanup-stage trophy: if it has not unlocked naturally by the endgame, experiment with partner activities in front of crowds from a reloadable save. Do not trust any source, including this one, that states a precise trigger the official wording does not support.
steps: Play partner activities during the story (inference-based)
Choose showy, public options when with your partner
If it never pops, experiment with partner crowd activities in the Cleanup stage
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); partnership-and-crowd interpretation is editorial inference from that wording

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A counter in cryptic clothing: the description says choices made, for better or worse, and PlayStation tracks a count for it — 500 choices, per the starter data drawn from the official list. So the method is volume with awareness: the game evidently counts the choices you make across its systems, and five hundred of them will mostly accumulate through honest play — dialogue picks, purchases, approaches, responses — provided you keep playing varied content rather than repeating one loop. Check the tracked count on the trophy itself in the PlayStation list if you want your exact progress; the console shows it. Late in Stage 4, if the count lags, choose the cheap, repeatable choices your play has already found and grind the remainder deliberately. Neither good nor bad choices are specified — 'for better or worse' says both count.
steps: Make choices across dialogue, purchases and approaches as you play
Check the tracked count on the trophy in the PlayStation list
Grind cheap repeatable choices in Stage 4 until 500
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); tracked count of 500 as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description is a shrug in trophy form: 'Second time's the charm.' Our inference, labelled as such: the trophy rewards succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing it once — a retry-then-succeed moment. The honest method is therefore not to hunt a location but to change a habit: when you fail a challenge, race, range round or activity, immediately retry it and succeed, rather than moving on — somewhere in that ordinary loop this trophy lives. If you are a flawless player, engineer it cheaply at cleanup: deliberately fail the easiest repeatable challenge once, then complete it on the retry. We do not claim a more specific trigger, because the official wording does not offer one.
steps: When you fail any repeatable activity, retry it at once (inference-based)
Succeed on the second attempt
Or at cleanup: fail the easiest challenge once, then complete the retry
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); fail-then-succeed interpretation is editorial inference from that wording

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The vaguest description on the list, and we will not pretend otherwise: 'What the hell just happened?' plus a title about the truth being out there points, by inference, at witnessing something strange — the series has a long tradition of odd encounters, unexplained lights and weird strangers in remote places at odd hours. The practical translation: explore the map's lonely corners, especially at night, follow up strange encounters and unusual markers instead of driving past them, and linger when something odd begins rather than leaving. Exploration trophies will take you to the right kinds of places anyway, so this pairs with The Goodtime State. If it pops, it will probably surprise you mid-exploration — that surprise is the design. Any guide claiming an exact trigger from this wording alone is guessing louder than us.
steps: Explore remote areas, including at night (inference-based)
Investigate strange encounters and unusual markers
Linger when something odd starts until the moment resolves
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); strange-encounter interpretation is editorial inference, in the series' tradition of odd encounters in GTA V (Rockstar Games, 2013)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — striking a pedestrian or enemy with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling them over, hence Ten Pin. You need a vehicle that allows a melee swing from the driver's position; a motorcycle or open vehicle is the natural candidate if cars do not allow it. Line up a single target somewhere open and quiet, ride past at moderate speed — fast enough to be a drive-by, slow enough to connect — and swing as you pass. One clean knockdown is the whole trophy. Do it away from police attention so the experiment stays free, and retry freely; this is a technique trophy, not a grind.
steps: Take a motorcycle or open vehicle
Find a lone target in an open, quiet spot
Ride past and knock them down with a melee swing
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn a quarter of a million dollars by laundering marked bills through your contacts. This is an economy trophy with a specific pipeline: marked bills come from crime — robberies and heists are the obvious sources — and contacts convert them into clean earnings at, the title jokes, a dime on the dollar. So feed the pipeline deliberately: rob for marked bills during Stage 5's crime run, launder every batch through your contacts rather than letting dirty money sit, and track the laundered total, not your cash balance, because only laundered earnings count. Two hundred and fifty thousand is a real sum, so start the habit early — every robbery from Stage 2 onward can contribute if its proceeds pass through your contacts.
steps: Earn marked bills from robberies and heists
Launder every batch through your contacts
Continue until $250,000 has been earned by laundering
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend one hundred thousand dollars across all shops — cumulative, across every shop type, not in one spree. This trophy rewards a lifestyle: buy your vehicles, clothes, weapons, upgrades and services at full price as you play, rather than hoarding cash, and the counter fills itself. The trap is the opposite instinct — players who steal everything and buy nothing arrive at cleanup rich and trophy-poor. If you do reach Stage 5 short, the fastest honest finish is big-ticket shopping: vehicles and property-adjacent purchases move the counter in chunks. Keep the money loop healthy by pairing spending with the robbery and laundering income from the rest of Stage 5.
steps: Buy equipment, vehicles and services at shops throughout the game
Avoid hoarding: spend as you earn
If short in Stage 5, finish with big-ticket purchases to reach $100,000
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties, per the starter data drawn from the official list. Garages are bought with money earned elsewhere, so this trophy sits downstream of the whole Stage 5 economy: rob, launder, and let Treat Yo Self's spending habit spare the property fund. Buy garages as they become affordable rather than saving for all eight at once — each garage is also useful storage for the vehicle collection your discovery and registration trophies are building. If a garage's purchase prompt needs a story unlock first, note it and return after the relevant chapter. The eighth purchase is the one that pops it.
steps: Earn money through Stage 5 crime and laundering
Buy each garage property as it becomes affordable
Purchase all 8 garages
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); garage count of 8 as carried in the competition starter data from the official list (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The workflow writes itself once you find the app: whenever you acquire or discover a vehicle worth keeping, register it before you abandon it, and ten registrations accumulate almost incidentally alongside Whip It Good's hundred discoveries. If registration requires ownership or a photo or parking step, the app itself will teach it on the first vehicle — do that teaching moment early, during the story, so every later vehicle is a ten-second registration instead of a mystery. Ten is a small number; the only way to make it slow is to start it late.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app and learn registration on your first vehicle
Register every keeper vehicle as you acquire it
Continue until 10 vehicles are registered
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
